cv.title: CV
cv.description: CV and experience page of Ruben Rodriguez Pardo.
cv.summary-d: <0>My name is Ruben Rodriguez Pardo. In 2017 I graduated as a Multimedia Engineer from the University of Alicante, Spain.</0><0>After graduating, I decided to sharpen my skills as a game developer. Along the way I founded my own brand, Frasquito Games, under which I publish the projects I develop independently.</0><0>In 2021 I made the move into the industry. Since then I have built up more than five years of experience as a game developer: first at Monti Games and Magic Media, developing casual games for Electronic Arts' Pogo platform, and since late 2024 at Linko Studios, an exclusive studio partner of Games Global, where I develop HTML5 slots for regulated online casinos.</0>

2.title: Pachinko Linko 5
2.subtitle: Second project, a new title built on Linko 5
2.description: Second title in the series. I developed the Spine-animated character system, the coin rain with a shader-based fireworks finale, the quick-speed popup and the layout rework for any screen ratio. I also handled sound integration, per-market localization and QA bug fixing.

3.title: Linko 5
3.subtitle: First project, the studio's debut title
3.description: The game Games Global used to introduce Linko Studios in February 2026. I joined in the early stages and worked until launch on the free spins, the Linko Wheel, the wilds and their animations, recovery of interrupted rounds, the sound system, portrait and landscape views, and bug fixing through to production.

linko.description: I am part of the development team at Linko Studios, an exclusive studio partner of Games Global that builds HTML5 slots for online casinos. I take part in the whole life cycle of the games, from the early stages through launch and later maintenance: I implement mechanics and features, look after performance and how each game adapts to mobile and desktop, and work with the art, design and QA teams to take each title to production.

linko5.title: Linko 5
linko5.subtitle: Five coins in a line: the Linko Studios debut
linko5.description: Professional HTML5 slot developed in Cocos Creator for Linko Studios, distributed exclusively by Games Global.
linko5.excerpt: The debut title from Linko Studios. Land five coins on any horizontal, vertical or diagonal line and add up their values, with wilds, free spins, mystery boxes and the Linko Wheel.
linko5.content: <0>Linko 5 is the game Games Global used to introduce Linko Studios in February 2026. Its mechanic is original and easy to grasp: landing five coins on any horizontal, vertical or diagonal line awards the sum of their values.</0><0>Around that idea there is a permanent wild in the centre of the grid that can transform to boost coin values or respin the empty positions, diamond wilds that link coin chains and open the free spins, mystery boxes holding higher-value coins, and the Linko Wheel, which awards wild rain, multipliers, instant coin collection and jackpots.</0><0>I joined the client team in the early stages of the project and worked on it until launch. I took care of the free spins (intro, counter, retrigger and outro), the Linko Wheel and its prizes, the wild and anticipation animations, recovery of interrupted rounds, the sound system and its debugging tools, the portrait and landscape views, and QA bug fixing through to production.</0>

pachinko-linko.title: Pachinko Linko 5
pachinko-linko.subtitle: The Linko mechanic in a Japanese setting
pachinko-linko.description: Professional HTML5 slot developed in Cocos Creator for Linko Studios, distributed exclusively by Games Global.
pachinko-linko.excerpt: Second title in the Linko 5 series, with a Japanese setting, an animated character that reacts to the game and a coin rain that ends in fireworks.
pachinko-linko.content: <0>Pachinko Linko 5 takes the five-coins-in-a-line mechanic to a Japanese setting, with jackpots, free spins, feature purchase and the Linko Wheel.</0><0>The project started from the Linko 5 base, and much of the work was turning that base into a game with its own identity. I developed the character system: a lucky cat animated with Spine that reacts to what happens in the game and has to handle state changes cleanly while its animations are still loading. I also built the coin rain, with a fireworks finale implemented with shaders.</0><0>I reworked the layout so the game adapts to any screen ratio, including stretched resolutions, and added the quick-speed popup. The rest of my work covered sound integration, per-market localization (some jurisdictions require different terminology), a tool to inspect the running scene, and fixing the bugs found by QA.</0>

slots.title: Pogo Slots
slots.subtitle: Endless rewards in the unique machines of Pogo Slots
slots.description: Professional game developed in Cocos Creator for the Pogo platform by Electronic Arts.
slots.excerpt: Win big with Pogo Slots! Choose your fun with two unique slot machines: Nile's Purramid and Grant's Garden. Spin, fill quest cards, and win, win, win!
slots.content: <0>Experience the thrill of winning with Pogo Slots. Our game features two unique slot machines, Nile's Purramid and Grant's Garden, each with its own captivating gameplay. Complete fun-filled quests for rewards and leverage the powerups to win even more. With Pogo Slots, every player is a winner!</0><0>Collect rewards every hour of every day in the Lobby! Relax and take stock of all your earnings before you jump into the world of either of our unique slot machines:</0><0>Experience the mystique of Nile's Purramid, a slot machine that takes you through the enigmatic world of ancient Egypt, promising thrilling rewards at every spin. Find meaning and winnings in the myriad hieroglyphs and paylines.</0><0>Indulge in the peaceful ambiance of Grant's Garden, a slots paradise that showers you with bountiful winnings amidst a serene garden setting. With Grant’s Garden’s match style payouts–winning never stops–each time you win, more symbols drop down to keep the winning combos going! Can you get the elusive Triple Blossom combo?</0><0>This online casino game is available to all players, no registration required, and offers free spins so you'll never get bored!</0>

risk.title: Risk Pogo Domination
risk.subtitle: Conquer territories and dominate the world
risk.description: Professional game developed in Cocos Creator for the Pogo platform by Electronic Arts.
risk.excerpt: Attack, defend, fortify, and expand your territory as you battle other players to control the world in this classic board game. Strategically move your military units and roll the dice to conquer lands.
risk.content: <0>RISK: Pogo Domination is the classic board game experience, with a Pogo twist! Play with up to 6 other Pogo™ players in three different RISK game modes. In the Classic mode, the key to victory is conquering all the territories in the world. In Capital mode, defend your capital from invaders while trying to conquer rival capitals. In Secret Mission mode, everyone has their own secret plan to win the game. Can you complete your secret mission before your opponents complete theirs?</0><0>Claim territories in turns to stake your claim on a piece of the world. Reinforce your territories with a selection of aesthetically unique military units to quickly attack your opponents. Roll your customizable dice to determine the fate of entire nations. Fortify military units through your international supply lines to repel potential attackers, or prepare the beachhead for your next assault!</0><0>Earn RISK cards in each round. Match 3 of the same cards to get bonus troops that will help you crush your opponents or pull you back from the brink of defeat.</0>

yahtzee.title: Yahtzee Wild
yahtzee.subtitle: Classic dice and board game
yahtzee.description: Professional game developed in Cocos Creator for the Pogo platform by Electronic Arts.
yahtzee.excerpt: Play Yahtzee! with family and friends just as you remember it. Compete for the highest Yahtzee score on a real-time leaderboard as you roll the dice in a series of timed rounds.
yahtzee.content: <0>In Yahtzee Wild, you can compete with up to 11 players to achieve the highest Yahtzee score. Players will have 13 rounds to roll 5 dice and create 'poker-like' hands. In each round, players will have 3 rolls to try to maximize their point value. In each roll, they can choose to keep or re-roll any of their 5 dice. Strategically keep the dice to create 3 of a kind, 4 of a kind, a full house, or even go all out and get the elusive 5 of a kind Yahtzee! Players will track their overall progress on the scorecard. Once all 13 rounds are completed, all players will compare their scorecards to see who has earned the most points and claim the top spot on the leaderboard.</0><0>Yahtzee Wild introduces the possibility of using 'Wild Dice.' Players can substitute any die in the round with a 'Wild Die.' These powerful wild cards can be used for any number. Use these dice strategically to complete specific hands and maximize your points. Registered Pogo players can earn Zee Coins by playing, allowing them to purchase and use Wild Dice.</0>

scrabble.title: Scrabble
scrabble.subtitle: A classic crossword game
scrabble.description: Professional game developed in Cocos Creator for the Pogo platform by Electronic Arts.
scrabble.excerpt: Put your letters into play with SCRABBLE online for free! Play alone or challenge your friends in this classic free online word game.
scrabble.content: <0>Play SCRABBLE online for free on Pogo™! Practice your skills against computer opponents, or create a SCRABBLE game with your family and friends. You can even take on other Pogo™ players matched to your skill level. Free users and Club Pogo members also have access to other fun game modes!</0><0>In the classic SCRABBLE game, you take turns creating words on the game board using letters from your tray. Each letter is worth a certain number of points, which contribute to the total score for your word.</0><0>Use the board to your advantage by placing words on one or more premium squares, such as 'Double Letter Score' or 'Triple Word Score.' Turn even the humblest of words into a big winner!</0>

touch-the-coin.title: Touch the Coin
touch-the-coin.subtitle: Hypercasual mobile game
touch-the-coin.description: Personal game project developed with PhaserJS and deployed on mobile devices.
touch-the-coin.excerpt: Chase coins with a simple tap. Earn extra time, create combos, and enjoy quick and addictive games anytime.
touch-the-coin.content: <0>'Touch the Coin' is a Hypercasual genre game that challenges you to reach coins with the ball you control. The mechanics are simple: with simple taps on the screen, you can change the direction of the ball. Each time you reach a coin, you gain additional time. Link them quickly to trigger combos and get extra time!</0><0>This game is highly addictive and perfect for quick matches anytime, anywhere.</0>

pet-balls.title: Pet Balls
pet-balls.subtitle: Master physics with these round pets
pet-balls.description: Personal game project developed with Cocos Creator.
pet-balls.excerpt: Pet Balls is a project conceived to explore and test the capabilities of the Cocos Creator engine.
pet-balls.content: <0>Pet Balls is a game project designed with the primary purpose of testing and evaluating the performance of the Cocos Creator engine, specifically version 2.3.3. The game is characterized by its focus on simple physics-based mechanics, leveraging the Box2D physics engine, which has been adapted and customized for seamless integration with the Cocos Creator environment.</0><0>This game offers a diverse experience with a total of 15 levels, distributed across 5 types of mini-games and 3 levels of difficulty. In other words, three increasing levels of complexity are presented for each of the 5 'pets' that players can control.</0><0>The 'pets' are round-shaped animated creatures that interact with their environment through collisions. These 5 types of 'pets' include the bird, the fish, the octopus, the monkey, and the frog, each with unique mechanics that challenge players to complete levels creatively and strategically.</0>

mix-ball.title: Mix Ball
mix-ball.subtitle: Physics-based project with PhaserJS
mix-ball.description: Personal game project developed with PhaserJS.
mix-ball.excerpt: Take control of a unique ball and navigate through strategic collisions with green tiles to progress. But beware, other tiles can introduce unexpected challenges to your journey.
mix-ball.content: <0>Mix Ball is a casual game developed using the PhaserJS framework, created with the purpose of exploring and testing this technology to understand its potential and capabilities.</0><0>The game is characterized by offering simple, quick-resolution levels, where players take control of a ball with specific attributes that set it apart from other balls present in the game. The goal is to guide the ball to the level's end through collisions with green tiles in the environment. However, caution is needed when interacting with other tiles and their attributes, as they can present additional challenges on the journey.</0>

haciendo-campana.title: Haciendo Campaña
haciendo-campana.subtitle: Game for CPCRetroDev
haciendo-campana.description: Personal game project developed in C++ for the Amstrad CPC 464 microcomputer.
haciendo-campana.excerpt: Multiplayer showdowns, where two characters compete for domination of strategic areas on the stage. Conquer strategically placed banners to ensure victory in a stage full of obstacles and objects that will influence your campaign performance.
haciendo-campana.content: <0>'Haciendo Campaña' is a real-time strategy game designed for the Amstrad CPC 464 platform, with a special focus on multiplayer gameplay.</0><0>The game offers exciting quick matches where two characters, either controlled by players or by AI (CPU), face off in a battle to conquer the different available areas on the stage. At the end of the match time, the player who has managed to conquer the most areas (identified through strategically placed banners) is crowned the winner.</0><0>The stage is designed with obstacles and objects that influence gameplay, requiring strategy and skill to secure victory in the campaign. The game features a multiplayer mode, making it ideal for challenging your friends to exciting showdowns. You can also face off against the CPU in an engaging single-player mode.</0>

prisionero.title: Prisionero
prisionero.subtitle: Freedom through reputation in Prisionero.
prisionero.description: Personal game project developed in C++ and SFML.
prisionero.excerpt: Control the prisoner and use characters' reputations to escape challenging rooms. Your cleverness is key to opening the door to the next level. Are you ready for the challenge?
prisionero.content: <0>Prisionero is a puzzle game prototype designed to implement and test various Artificial Intelligence algorithms.</0><0>In this game, you will embark on the exciting mission of escaping from each room that presents itself to the prisoner, whom you will control as the main player. Use characters' reputations to overcome challenging obstacles and open the door that leads you to the next level.</0>
